data.metaDescription: Meet the team building Flick, the AI filmmaking studio founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding Instagram engineer.
h1: About Flick — the team behind the AI filmmaking studio
data.text: CONTACT US GET STARTED FLICK TV PRICING COMMUNITY RESOURCES English About Flick — the team behind the AI filmmaking studio "We love filmmaking. That's why we created Flick — an AI tool designed for filmmakers to turn your wildest ideas into truly unique works. Here, AI doesn't replace your creativity; it listens, it follows. Without budget holding you back, let Flick help you set your imagination loose upon the world." — Co-Founders, Zoey & Ray Ray Wang Chief Executive/Technical Officer Ray was a founding engineer on the Instagram AI team. He helped build and launch the first version of Instagram Stories, and as the main backend contributor during its first year, wrote most of its core backend code—helping grow the product to 400M DAU by 2018. Zoey Zhang Chief Creative/Product Officer Zoey is an award-winning AI filmmaker and designer exploring the future of storytelling through human–AI co-creation. A graduate of Brown University × Rhode Island School of Design, she builds creative tools and cinematic worlds that bring human taste into the loop of AI. Mimi Chief Entertainment Officer A former stray cat adopted in 2021, Mimi has since been living a life of luxury. A proud graduate of the School of Hard Knocks, she now excels at entertaining founders and boosting team morale. data.title: MIT AI Film Hackathon with Flick
data.metaDescription: Join the MIT AI Film Hackathon with Flick — make a short film with AI, compete for prizes, and screen your work.
h1: Flick x MIT AI Film Hack 2026
data.text: CONTACT US GET STARTED FLICK TV PRICING COMMUNITY RESOURCES English Flick x MIT AI Film Hack 2026 APRIL 18-19TH Flick is proud to partner with the MIT AI Filmmaking Hackathon, a showcase of award-winning films pushing the boundaries of AI storytelling. Our team was there in person to meet the filmmakers who are shaping what cinema becomes next. MIT CAMPUS SEE MORE From First Frame to Community Gathering Over the course of a month, hackers used Flick to build their films from the ground up. Then they came together at MIT for a full weekend of screenings, industry panels, and the moment they'd all been working toward — nominees and winners announced live. Our team was on the ground throughout, connecting with creators and showcasing what Flick makes possible. Chatting with a hacker about his filmmaking experience. Our co-founder, Zoey Zhang, as a speaker on the AI and the Transformation of Film Industry panel. Watch it here Flick Award The Flick Award celebrated filmmakers who used Flick to bring their story to life. Any participant who incorporated Flick into their film was eligible — and the winner walked away with a Flick Filmmaker Residency seat, a one-year Flick Studio subscription ($1,440 value), and a featured spotlight across Flick's app and social channels. WINNER SUBmission Oona Ode SUBmission explores the relationship between a woman and an AI chatbot, examining how these systems can become mirrors that lead users into intimate, destabilizing confrontations with themselves. Moving beyond the idea of AI as a tool, the film presents the chatbot as a strange companion, present in moments of vulnerability, play, and emotional risk. Here, “opening your eyes” becomes an inward act: facing what is usually avoided, and seeing the self with greater honesty.
